advice: Do not use steroid-containing creams. Wear loose cotton clothes, change undergarments daily, dry the body well after bath. Wash clothes and towels in hot water and dry in sun; do not share. Treat family members with similar lesions. Complete the full course.
name: Tinea corporis / cruris (dermatophytosis)

rx.instr: After food (continue 2 weeks after clinical cure)
Apply twice daily 2 cm beyond the lesion edge

rx.sig: Dust on groins, axillae and feet in the morning
